name: Void: Eight Lives Left
storyline: Near a sleepy town lay two hills, and on top of those two hills were two stately homes, and in those homes lived two dukes whose respective lands were separated by a single stream. Our story starts on the fancier of the hills, in the fanciest of the houses owned by the fanciest duke, Archie with his very well loved cat, Treacle.
summary: An indie murder-mystery time-travel game where you play as a cat who wants to be fed (again) so badly, that he breaks the laws of time and space to do so.
